heading: What the user accepts
text:
### What the user accepts [LNOG.1.2]

`logical: false` is an opt-in constraint.  Users who choose it accept:

- No `logical`-lifecycle schema declarations in the program.
- No `emit X logical` on any schema, including schemas declared in
  imported files.
- No automatic retraction of derived facts: every emitted fact persists
  until it expires via TTL, is explicitly retracted by a rule, or the
  engine is reset.
- With `linear_scan: false` as well: no multi-pattern rules at all
  (see [LNOG.6]).

In return they get the algorithmic properties in [LNOG.5]: a
retraction path that has no TMS lookup, no cascade, and no depth
multiplier in T_wcet.
